bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Acquires 2,500 Bitcoin for $185 Million
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. has expanded its corporate treasury by acquiring 2,500 Bitcoin for approximately $185 million, bringing its total holdings to nearly 19,000 BTC.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Olenox Industries Reports May 2026 Bitcoin Production
bitcoin_articles.summary: Olenox Industries released its first monthly operating update following the acquisition of CS Digital Ventures, reporting 18.6 Bitcoin produced in May 2026.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Sphere 3D Completes Acquisition of Cathedra Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sphere 3D Corp. has finalized its business combination with Cathedra Bitcoin Inc., creating a scaled digital infrastructure platform with 53 MW of operational capacity.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Sphere 3D and Cathedra Bitcoin Complete Business Combination
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sphere 3D Corp. and Cathedra Bitcoin Inc. have finalized their previously announced plan of arrangement, with Cathedra now operating as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sphere 3D.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Hyperscale Data Announces Updated Bitcoin Treasury Holdings of Approximately 704 Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. reported that its subsidiaries, Sentinum, Inc. and Ault Capital Group, Inc., collectively held 704.3405 Bitcoin as of May 31, 2026.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Adds 2,500 Bitcoin to Treasury Holdings
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. has expanded its corporate Bitcoin treasury by acquiring an additional 2,500 BTC.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BP Reportedly Transfers BTC Pipeline Operations to SOCAR
bitcoin_articles.summary: BP is reportedly set to transfer the operational management of the Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan (BTC) pipeline to Azerbaijan's state energy company, SOCAR.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Deposits Assets to Coinbase Prime
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock has deposited 900 Bitcoin and 17,511 Ethereum into its Coinbase Prime accounts.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Satsuma Technology Tightens Costs as It Pivots From Bittensor to Bitcoin Lightning Network
bitcoin_articles.summary: Satsuma Technology PLC is implementing cost-cutting measures while shifting its strategic focus from Bittensor-related initiatives to the Bitcoin Lightning Network.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Sterling Digital Plc Enters Contract with Terra Solis Mining and Opens Coinbase Custodian Account
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sterling Digital Plc has signed a contract with Terra Solis Mining LLC for gas-to-energy mining site support and established a Bitcoin custodian account with Coinbase.

bitcoin_articles.headline: CME Group Launches 24/7 Trading for Bitcoin Volatility Futures
bitcoin_articles.summary: CME Group has officially launched 24/7 trading for its Bitcoin Volatility futures, providing institutional investors with continuous access to regulated volatility hedging tools.
